responsibility: Declares the buffering layer used by diagnostic_context to accumulate emitted diagnostics before they are flushed to output. It defines diagnostic_buffer, which tracks buffered diagnostic counts and owns one per-format buffer for each active diagnostic_output_format, and the abstract diagnostic_per_format_buffer interface that text, SARIF, and other formatters implement to store, move, clear, and flush their buffered representation, making this the format-aware staging API for delayed emission and group-preserving diagnostic handling.
